title: Compact Route Latency Ribbon Tileboard — responsive tiles & cost attribution microcharts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, responsive tileboard for per-route and per-model surface in the Redwood Console that surfaces latency distributions, throughput trends, token mix, and immediate cost attribution in a single, scannable row. This ticket covers UX patterns, visual-specs for four microcharts per tile (latency ribbon, throughput sparkline, token-breakdown bar, cost-stack mini-area), interactions for expansion to a detailed microtrace, and rollout-aware overlays so product teams can see model-version rollouts inline.

acceptance_criteria: Tile fits in a single console row at 1280px width showing title, model chip, latency ribbon (p50/p90/p99), throughput sparkline, token-breakdown microbars, and cost-stack microarea.
Hover/expand reveals a microtrace preview and link to full Trace Viewer.
Rollout overlay displays version, traffic %, and an inline fallback suggestion if model variant is degraded.
All charts use accessible color palette and have tooltips with exact numeric values and 95% CI when available.
Prototype renders 50 simultaneous tiles in a grid without exceeding 60ms frame budget on an M1-class dev VM (synthetic test).
Engineering has signed off on metrics contract or created dependency ticket ENG-68911.
Unit tests / storybook stories exist for collapsed and expanded tile states.
decisions: Use a horizontal 'latency ribbon' that encodes p50/p90/p99 with layered translucent bars rather than stacked bars to preserve density.
Throughput will be a 60px wide sparkline with sampling at configurable intervals (default 1m); on hover show per-bin legend.
Token-breakdown uses 3 microbars: input, generated, cached (colors: blue, green, gray) with absolute token counts in tooltip.
Cost attribution microarea stacks cost by quantization tier (fp32/int8/qat) when available; otherwise display 'cost unknown' state.
Small-screen breakpoint collapses throughput into a single spark-dot and moves token-breakdown into an expansion panel to preserve tap targets.
Rollout badge uses a 3-state color system: green (healthy), amber (partial rollout / degraded), red (fallback active).
ux_notes: Micro-interactions: hover reveals numeric callout; long-press (mobile) opens inline details; double-click on tile title jumps to route detail page. Maintain 8px spacing and 4px corner radius for all tiles. Use aria-labels for p50/p90/p99 and add 'aria-describedby' linking to tooltip content.
